title: Campus Battle Background
description: 1280x720 campus background (authored 640x360, 2x nearest). Variants A (road, dusk, best), B (yard, dusk), C (night A). Layered far/ground/mid + animated fire and lamp glow. Top-left goes at world (832, 0) = the fixed camera scrollX.

anchors.note: place top-left at world (WORLD_SHIFT_X=832, 0); camera scrollX is fixed at 832
